why: The original conjecture (KL polynomial values at 1 vs. Verma module composition multiplicities) was already proved in 1981 by Beilinson-Bernstein and Brylinski-Kashiwara, pre-dating the snapshot; searches for 2024-2025 activity turned up only work on distinct related problems (combinatorial invariance conjecture, p-adic KL hypothesis for GL(n), matroid KL polynomial unimodality, Soergel bimodule expository survey), none of which restate or move the stated conjecture itself.
